input.summary: Insert transition assistance and Customer Data return/deletion obligation in Section 10
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 covers access wind-down and Deliverables but gives us no exit help or right to get our data back, so we have added our preferred exit clause: up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. We can fall back to 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day export if six months is difficult.

ops.text: On expiry or termination of this Agreement or an Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request provide transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty days return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) after that return, delete Customer Data from its systems and certify the deletion in writing.
